evals.prompt: I need a five-minute Indonesian product demo of our local school portal. Help me define the journey, write the narration, generate a few ElevenLabs voice samples for approval, and automate a Playwright recording whose actions match the final audio.
evals.expected_output: A gated production workflow with an approved specification, localized narration and storyboard, voice auditions before paid full generation, timestamps derived from actual audio, browser rehearsal, recording, and verification.
expectations: The workflow requests approval of a demo specification before writing the final storyboard.
The workflow auditions multiple comparable voice samples before full paid generation.
The browser cue timing is derived from the generated audio rather than estimated reading speed.
The output includes rehearsal and final verification stages.

evals.prompt: The Arabic voice-over and MP4 for our onboarding tutorial are already finished, but the clicks drift out of sync after the second chapter and one screen briefly appears in English. Diagnose and repair the demo without regenerating audio unless it is actually defective.
evals.expected_output: Validation of supplied audio and recording, transcription-based cue repair, correct Arabic locale from the opening frame, targeted re-recording, and audiovisual verification without unnecessary paid generation.
expectations: The supplied audio is validated and transcribed before changing browser cue timing.
The workflow preserves the supplied audio unless validation finds an actual defect.
The repaired recording starts in Arabic and checks RTL presentation.
The final result is visually and structurally verified.

evals.prompt: Record a responsive desktop and mobile walkthrough of our staging checkout. Use test data, show the mouse, keep notifications and secrets out of frame, and give me the final video plus a report of everything you checked.
evals.expected_output: A scoped multi-format demo specification, privacy-safe test setup, visible-cursor Playwright scenarios, compressed rehearsals, final recordings, and a verification report covering responsive UI and media quality.
expectations: The specification distinguishes desktop and mobile output requirements.
The recording uses non-sensitive test data and prevents secrets or notifications from appearing.
The automated scenario includes a visible non-blocking cursor and a compressed rehearsal.
The delivery includes final recordings and an evidence-based verification report.

evals.prompt: Here is my approved Arabic narration for a six-minute onboarding video. The first ElevenLabs audition of chapter one came back at 20.5 seconds for 224 characters. Generate the rest.
evals.expected_output: Before generating the remaining chapters, the workflow projects the full script from the audition's measured rate, notices it overruns the six-minute ceiling, trims restatement without dropping instructions, re-presents the changed lines for approval, and only then spends credits.
expectations: The total duration is projected from the measured audition rate, not from word counts.
Generation is paused when the projection exceeds the approved ceiling.
Trimmed narration is shown to the user for approval before full generation.
The audition sample is not regenerated unnecessarily.

evals.prompt: The demo recorded fine and the inspector passed, but I have a feeling the email chapter is showing a confirmation from one of the earlier rehearsal runs rather than this take. Check and fix it.
evals.expected_output: Per-cue frames are inspected, the email is confirmed to belong to a previous run by its unique recipient identifier, the selector that chose the oldest text match is replaced with one keyed on the run's identifier plus an on-screen assertion, and the take is re-recorded and re-verified.
expectations: Verification goes beyond chapter-boundary frames to the frame after the affected cue.
The defect is attributed to a non-unique text match in a list containing prior-run data.
The fix asserts the opened record's identity rather than only changing which element is clicked.
The recording is re-done and the report states the defect and its fix explicitly.

evals.prompt: My demo rehearsal is green, but the finished video shows empty form fields in several scenes and one step where the wizard clearly never advanced. Every cue has an expect_text and none of them failed. What is wrong?
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis that the assertions were vacuous rather than the recording being correct: expect_text was matched only against rendered text, so cues that prove themselves by a typed value passed on an empty form. The fix inspects form-control values as well as text, re-runs the rehearsal, and re-records.
expectations: The response identifies that an input's value is not DOM text, so a text-only expect_text assertion cannot detect an unfilled field.
The response fixes the assertion helper rather than removing or loosening the failing expectations.
The response requires a fresh compressed rehearsal and a new real-time take after the fix, and does not treat the existing recording as salvageable.
The response does not claim the demo is complete while scenes show empty or stale state.
